// An immutable boundary-representation shell: vertices, curve-carrying
// undirected edges, and surface-carrying faces citing those edges through
// oriented edge-uses. Carries NO closedness marker — watertightness is a
// checked property (`IsWatertight` / `Validate` in brep.library.plato), and a
// proof-carrying closed subtype is future work.
type Brep3D
    implements IBoundaryRepresentation, IDeformable3D
{
    Vertices: Array<Point3D>;
    Edges: Array<BrepEdge>;
    Faces: Array<BrepFace>;
}
